data.name: The Howling Hills
data.author: Jianjun99
data.blurb: An outdoor bandit stronghold in the wind-scoured hills. A tougher delve for heroes of level 5-10, with a warboss on a war-drum.

monsters.name: Hills Bandit
monsters.blurb: A wind-burned cutthroat in scavenged leathers, more dangerous at counting coin than swinging a blade.

monsters.name: Dire Wolf
monsters.blurb: A pony-sized wolf with winter-pale eyes; the warboss's hunt-beasts answer only his drum.

monsters.name: Bandit Lieutenant
monsters.blurb: A scarred veteran who kept his post out of greed rather than loyalty; he fights like a man with something to prove.

monsters.name: Gorrash the Warboss
traits: Bound to the drum: Gorrash never strays from his war-drum.
monsters.blurb: A mountain of muscle and war-paint beating a drum made from a cart wheel — every beat drives the camp into a frenzy.

gear.name: Warboss's Banner
gear.desc: +1 to attack rolls while carried — the hills remember who owns this banner now.

gear.name: Wolf-Fur Cloak
gear.desc: +1 AC while worn. Smells faintly of wet dog, in a reassuring way.
